reason: I'd probably start the free 5 weeks, but 45 minutes a day with a baby who won't nap on schedule isn't happening, and by week two I'd have dropped off. I'd never get far enough to pay for the 8-week one.
objection: I can't find 45 minutes a day with a baby. If I miss a few days I feel behind and just stop.
would_change_my_mind: Short 10 to 15 minute sessions I can do during a nap, with a way to pick back up after missing days without starting over.
